issues.explanation: Numeric-string priorities like "10" are coerced to int and accepted, while the contract requires only integers 0, 10, 20 and treats wrong types as 422 invalid_priority.

conventions.evidence: database/migrations/2026_10_20_120000_create_totems_table.php:31-34, 2026_10_20_120001:991-994 and 2026_10_20_120002:1028-1030 have reversible down(); App/Models/Totem.php:556 and TotemPreset.php:607 use HasFactory with #[Fillable]; TotemAuthController.php:410 and TotemPairingCode.php:75 use Log::channel('audit'); docs/api/totem.md, docs/database-schema.md, docs/architecture.md and CHANGELOG.md updated

readability.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemApiController.php:264 resolveQueue and :282 parsePriority are small and named; app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php:30-33 documents request attributes; sibling style matched, no dead code

requirements.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemAuthController.php:316 covers invalid_code_format, :322-375 transaction with lockForUpdate plus conditional update, :392-400 token/entity response; app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php:443-478 checks totem/preset/entity plus intersection scope; routes/api.php:1448-1454 throttles 10/min and 30/min; config/cors.php:817-831 localhost patterns; but TotemApiController.php:284-285 coerces '/^[0-9]+/' strings to int so "10" passes instead of 422

scope.evidence: change.diff touches only totem BFF: models/migrations/factories, totem:pairing-code, TotemJwt, totem.auth/totem.entity middleware, routes/api.php, cors/services/phpunit config, docs and TotemApiTest; no unrelated refactors

security.evidence: AuthenticateTotem.php:443-460 returns 401 invalid_token for missing/forged/expired/inactive/mismatched and TotemAuthController.php:383 returns single 401 invalid_pairing_code with audit() at :408-411 never logging the code; TotemJwt.php:742 enforces secret >=32 chars and HS256 via firebase/php-jwt; config/cors.php:831 supports_credentials false

simplicity.evidence: TotemApiController.php:248 reuses App\Actions\IssueTicket with TicketChannel::Totem; TotemJwt.php:709 uses firebase/php-jwt; bootstrap/app.php:785 renders ThrottleRequestsException as rate_limited; no service layers or duplicated issuance rules

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Totem/TotemApiTest.php:1499 command happy/unknown, :1523 pairing consume/reuse, :1554-1578 format and same-401 cases, :1588 throttle 10/min, :1599-1637 token forgery/expiry/inactive/mismatch, :1659-1697 queue scope intersection, :1740 ticket sequence/channel plus :1760-1800 invalid/inactive/throttle 30/min, :1804-1834 CORS preflight/foreign-origin/TOTEM_WEB_ORIGIN

review.summary: Implements the full Totem BFF pairing flow, JWT auth with intersection queue scope, the three data endpoints via IssueTicket, throttles, CORS and docs with strong test coverage. Approve with a nit: fix priority parsing to reject numeric strings so only integer 0/10/20 pass.
